item.title: Design a Fair Group Handover Record
item.audience: the coordinator of a college project course
item.prompt_text: In a group project course, tutors ask students to record who completed each handover and what was delayed. Reports sometimes include classmates' private reasons for missing a meeting, although tutors mainly need to know whether the next group received the work. Write a memo proposing what a handover record should contain, how an exception could be raised privately, and how tutors could use the record without treating it as a full account of a student's contribution.
item.target_grammar: Nominalisation; concessive and conditional structures; careful distinctions between evidence and inference.
item.target_structure: State the purpose, show a usable record, describe a private exception path, and define what the record can support.

checklist.point: Define the handover information a tutor actually needs.
Provide a concrete example of an entry.
Explain a private route for relevant exceptions.
Explain why the record cannot determine total contribution by itself.
